help.title: How does it work?
help.intro: A free library for your 3D-printing files (STL, 3MF, OBJ). Everything stays on this device: nothing is uploaded and your original files are never changed.
help.step.add: Add: tap Add and choose files or a whole folder, or drag them into the window.
help.step.view: View: tap a model to rotate and zoom. The dimensions are shown below it.
help.step.name: Name: give each model its own name, tags and a note, so you know later what is what.
help.step.tidy: Select: tick models (top right) to move them to a folder, tag them or delete them together. Folders live inside the app; your files on disk are not touched.
help.step.dupes: Duplicates: find identical files under different names and clear them out.
help.step.colours: Colours: 3MF colours from Bambu Studio, OrcaSlicer and PrusaSlicer are shown. For OBJ, select the .mtl file together with the .obj.
help.step.backup: Backup: your library only lives in this browser. Make a backup now and then in Settings, also to switch devices.
help.step.install: Install: choose "Add to Home Screen" (iPhone/iPad via Share, Android via the menu) to use it as an app, also offline.
